title: next build fails on Next.js 16 with 'This build is using Turbopack, with a webpack config and no turbopack config'
symptoms: This build is using Turbopack, with a `webpack` config and no `turbopack` config.
The build fails even though next.config has no webpack key, because a plugin such as next-pwa or an SVG loader adds one
cause: Next.js 16 builds with Turbopack by default and refuses to silently ignore a webpack function, since that config would not apply.
fix: Port the webpack rules to the turbopack key, or keep webpack for builds with the --webpack flag until the plugin supports Turbopack.
affected: Next.js 16.0 and later, any config or plugin that sets webpack
